---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability with a measurable integration target
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What user, research or product problem should this solve?

## Proposed capability

Describe the smallest useful behavior, not only the implementation technology.

## Acceptance evidence

Define how we know it works:

- [ ] implementation exists
- [ ] runtime path reaches it
- [ ] end-to-end execution succeeds
- [ ] observed effect is measured
- [ ] persistence/reuse is tested if the feature learns

## Integration boundary

Which EIDOS layers are involved?

- perception / browser / desktop
- memory / graph
- Colony / arbitration
- action / body / Bridge
- verification
- learning / capability reuse
- packaging / deployment

## Safety / rollback

What permissions are needed? What can go wrong? How is it disabled or rolled back?

## Alternatives considered

Why is this preferable to a one-off script, prompt, model adapter or external dependency?
